title: /api/tracker-overview
responsibility: Owns the owner-only /api/tracker-overview HTTP endpoint: the GET read of the stored Project Overview snapshot and the native PUT publish.

outputs.name: GET
outputs.description: Runs the policy directly. The owner's current ready snapshot answers 200 with Cache-Control private, no-store; any other owner-authorized read answers 503 with exactly {status:'unavailable'}.

outputs.name: PUT
outputs.description: Runs the policy. Only the owner's native bearer in the projects scope may publish; a valid snapshot is stored with the server receive time and answers 204 with no body.

errors.name: not-found
errors.description: The owner setting is missing or the path is not the exact one. The body is the opaque {error:'not-found'} and carries no CORS grant.

errors.name: session-required
errors.description: No verified session resolves from the request. The body is not read.

errors.name: forbidden
errors.description: A verified actor other than the owner, or a browser cookie on PUT.

errors.name: invalid-input
errors.description: A query on GET or PUT, or a publish body that is not a strict, consistent JSON snapshot.

errors.name: artifact-too-large
errors.description: A publish body over 256 KiB, refused while the stream is read.

inputs.name: GET.request
inputs.description: The GET or PUT request for the exact path /api/tracker-overview. Cookie or native bearer credentials are read by the verified session resolver.

inputs.name: GET.platform
inputs.description: The host platform bindings (D1, R2 and private settings) read for this one request. Missing settings answer the opaque not-found.
